---
name: Architectural RFC / Feature Request
about: Propose an architectural enhancement or new subsystem
title: '[RFC] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

---

**Is your proposal related to an architectural problem? Please describe.**
A clear and concise description of what the architectural challenge is.

**Describe the Proposed Solution**
A clear and concise description of the design. Include:
- Architectural domain (Ring 0, HAL, PMM, VMM, IPC, etc.)
- Invariants that must be maintained
- Draft Architecture Decision Record (ADR) reference if applicable

**Alternative Approaches Considered**
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

**Verification & Test Plan**
How will this design be verified deterministically under QEMU?
